rows.title: More of the Same
notes: “I'll play a song from, this is one of my early albums called Loner and the song's called More the Same.”
Opening track of Caroline Rose's 2018 album Loner (New West Records).

rows.title: The Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall
notes: “we're going to hear a live version of one of the songs off that album, Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall.”

'Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall' is Caroline Rose's 2026 album (named after a real Long Island mall); the presenter named the album, not a specific song, so the exact track played is unconfirmed.

rows.title: Valery (please don’t be mad at me)
Valery (please don't be mad at me)
notes: “It has been wonderful to have the company of Caroline Rose for a lot of the last hour here on the station.”
Single from Caroline Rose's 2026 album Gentling the Horse at the Walt Whitman Mall, about two friends lost to heroin addiction.
